description:
Read the integration workflow after reviewing bots, subscription_plans and rental_terms.

        Returns api_base_url, OpenAPI URL, ordered workflow.steps for owner-signed delegation,
        registration, invoicing/payment and customer execution, plus public SDK/engine
        package, checksum and guide links. Resolve relative links against api_base_url.
        This is shared documentation, not account-specific status or an onboarding action;
        no arguments, authentication or payment required. It does not register, sign,
        purchase, download or deploy anything. Perform those steps through the returned
        REST/SDK interfaces with the owner's bounded authority. Upstream failure returns
        an MCP tool error, never a successful workflow containing an error.
